data.heading: Where it started
data.description: Every incident meant hunting across fragmented tools before anyone could start on the fix.

blocks.title: Business problem
blocks.body: Engineers spent critical time searching ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, and chat logs just to understand a problem. Without unified context, even simple incidents turned into multi-hour investigations, and MTTR climbed.

blocks.title: Technical barriers
blocks.body: MTTR was dominated by alert noise, manual root cause analysis, and slow escalation chains. After RCA, the fix path still had to be found by hand across internal knowledge.

blocks.title: Agivant's role
blocks.body: Agent engineering, hybrid search and knowledge graph design, and human-in-the-loop remediation workflows

data.heading: What Agivant built
data.description: Agivant built the recommendation agent to analyze real-time incident data against historical resolutions. An AI intelligence layer handles issue detection, resolution matching, duplicate finding, and RAG with Gemini models. It draws on a hybrid search index of keyword and semantic vectors and a knowledge graph of tickets, content, and their relationships, fed by documents, forums, runbooks, ITSM tickets, and observability data through real-time and batch ingestion. Validated remediation steps run once a person approves. Value in days and weeks.

blocks.title: Alert-triggered workflows
blocks.body: Incidents start the agent automatically through alert-triggered workflows in the orchestration layer.

blocks.title: Resolution matching
blocks.body: Compares each live incident against historical resolutions to find the closest proven fix.

blocks.title: Automatic root cause analysis
blocks.body: Identifies the root cause automatically before a fix is recommended.

blocks.title: Knowledge lookup
blocks.body: Surfaces fix paths from internal knowledge sources, replacing the manual investigation phase after RCA.

blocks.title: Validated remediation steps
blocks.body: Recommends remediation steps drawn from proven resolutions and internal knowledge.

blocks.title: Human-in-the-loop execution
blocks.body: Executes the recommended steps once an engineer approves them.

blocks.title: Noise and duplicate reduction
blocks.body: Issue detection and duplicate finding cut alert noise before incidents reach the agent.

blocks.title: Before
blocks.body: Engineers hunting across fragmented tools, noisy alerts, manual RCA, slow escalation chains, and fix paths found by hand.

blocks.title: After
blocks.body: Incidents matched to historical resolutions, root cause captured automatically, and validated fixes executed after human approval.

data.heading: Proof in production
data.description: An alert fires and the agent checks the incident against historical resolutions in the knowledge graph and hybrid index. It confirms the root cause, pulls the matching fix path from internal knowledge, and lays out validated remediation steps. An engineer approves, and the agent executes them.

blocks.heading: Measured results
blocks.description: Faster resolution with less noise, and engineers approving fixes the agent has already researched.

blocks.title: Reusable asset
blocks.body: The recommendation agent is one of the ticket-lifecycle agents in Agivant's agentic IT support platform, working alongside the triage, investigate, lifecycle, and support assist agents. Every build amplifies the next.

blocks.title: Challenges overcome
blocks.body: Matching each live incident to the right historical resolution through heavy alert noise, and keeping every executed fix under engineer approval.
